refactor(camellia): align template and content surfaces

Summary:
- move template and specification list pages onto shared Card-backed table
  surfaces
- refactor content issue, tutorial, and feedback tables to the same shared
  surface model and button spacing
- remove the bespoke preview/editor treatment from template hidden flows in
  favor of preset-driven cards

Rationale:
- template, specification, and content routes still carried the most obvious
  route-local shells after the earlier preset checkpoints
- normalizing these families reduces remaining visual drift before the final
  system and universal passes

Tests:
- pnpm --dir bougainvillea run check:camellia
- PORT=3216 pnpm --dir bougainvillea --filter @bougainvillea/camellia start
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3216/template/classification
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3216/template/manage
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3216/template/manage/preview/tpl-shelf-202
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3216/template/manage/editor/tpl-shelf-202
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3216/specification/template
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3216/specification/classification
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3216/content/issue
